recorded_metadata_note: Compact original fixed-support metadata retained. The full historical coordinate/source audit stays local; it is not needed to reconstruct the 81 features. Current source qualifications are recorded separately.

source_qualifications.hotspot: Original manuscript reports MODIS Terra/Aqua via NASA FIRMS. Product collection, sensor continuity, original binning, filters, duplicates and day boundaries remain unverified; aggregate values are retained.
source_qualifications.dry_spell: Producer script uses CMORPH CRT, linear interpolation and inclusive <=1 in native units. Original CRT units and 9497-position MAT calendar correspondence remain qualified. The current exported daily assignment is retained.
source_qualifications.rain: NOAA CMORPH V1.0 ADJ, mm/day, 2001-2025 UTC-day subsets; spatial aggregates preserve the recorded run.
source_qualifications.evaporation: ECMWF signed accumulated depth, metres converted to millimetres; negative evaporation and positive condensation. Accumulation interval remains unconfirmed.
source_qualifications.wind: Mean of source-cell 10 m resultant speeds in m/s at the stored daily sample, not an established hourly-average daily speed.
source_qualifications.sst: Supplied Niño and west/east pole SST series; product, version, native units and pole construction remain unverified. Fitting-prefix monthly references must be reconstructed, not replaced by full-record climatologies.
source_qualifications.mjo: Supplied ROMI1, ROMI2 and archive amplitude match the NOAA PSL archive on all study dates; not RMM. Retrieval timing is not established.
